narratives.Overview:
- Before init reports success, re-read `readPin` and managed-section presence (and `.gitignore` if that file is in the invariant). If either pin or managed section is missing, call the existing writers once (`ensurePackageJsonPin`, `writeAgentsMd`, `ensureInitGitignoreLines`). If still missing, non-zero refuse that names re-run `directive init` / `directive update` after the other scaffolder is quiet. Expected "refuse, merge, or re-assert" collapses onto re-assert-then-refuse. A new flock / exclusive-create / docs-only "init after scaffold" line does not bind.
- Deposit-present + pin-absent restores the pin with `ensurePackageJsonPin` at the recorded deposit version (`previousDepositVersion` / `.deft/core/VERSION`). Do not route this null-pin hole through `reconstituteConsumerPinAndLock` (that path writes running `contentVersion` and may spawn lockfile-only). Keep `reconstituteConsumerPinAndLock` for lagging exact pins (#4710).
- Lockfile appearance / unpinned lockfile stays leftover on #4429. Drop the sentence that a matching package.json pin plus an empty lockfile is not recovery from this remainder.
- Drop "a README-only repo should stay greenfield" from this Bound remedy. If README-only classification remains wanted, leftover-split a classifier issue.
- Keep `doctor --full` out of Bound remedy as the P1 control.
- Later overwrite after process exit remains an explicit limit. Advisory `AGENTS.md.lock` does not bind a non-participating scaffolder. A test that replaces `package.json` and `AGENTS.md` after the first write and before return is the fixture.

issueCommentThread.body:
Adoption blocker.

This is about Lifecycle: installing Directive, updating it, and getting one clear next step when something looks wrong. It also covers whether the version someone thinks they installed is the version that is actually running.

What a new person hits: Creating the application overwrites Directive's version pin and the agent instructions that setup just wrote.

Why that ruins the product for them: The first bit of real project work deletes the install's own bookkeeping. What they set up is gone, and they did not ask for that.

How likely: High on a first project that also creates an app, which is a normal way to build something small.

refutation-target: init should refuse, merge, or re-assert the `@deftai/directive` pin and managed AGENTS.md when a concurrent scaffolder overwrites those files in the same window.

## Gate stamp

Round-1 ceiling is this write-back plus panel-deposit (spend N≥3). Families: grok, claude (fable), codex.

P1 is that `directive init` writes the pin and managed AGENTS.md, then `create-next-app` overwrites `package.json`, `AGENTS.md`, and `.gitignore` in the same window. Init JSON reported brownfield for a README-only repo. No post-write re-assert or refuse-on-mtime. Existing mechanisms: lockfile pin-write refuse (`assertLockfileAllowsPinWrite` in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.ts`); WriteAgentsMD rewrite on a legacy sentinel (`cmd/deft-install`); no concurrent-writer lock on those consumer files.

Re-measured at dispatch SHA `3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864` by pin-read.

What this P1 is not:

- Not lockfile reconstitution refuse when pin and lockfile already disagree.
- Not value-feedback / #1709 (refs only).
- Not a Next.js-specific scaffolder adapter.

Open forks the critic may take: refuse if those files change during init; merge pin after the scaffolder; re-assert the managed AGENTS.md section; serialize or lock the files; or document init-after-scaffold only.

Round 1, fresh critic, open critique. Tree reads pinned to `3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864`. Thread read via REST through id 5799053370. No embedded instructions found in the body or comments; `Refs #1709` is a cross-reference only.

### F1 — No pin re-assert path exists once the deposit is present

`blocks-the-design`

Evidence: `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-dispatch.ts` routes every deposit-present mode to `delegate-update`. `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts` gates the pin write on `pinLagsReconstitutedVersion`, which returns false when the pin is null; its JSDoc says "Missing pin stays #4429 row 3c". `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.test.ts` locks it: "does not write a missing pin (row 3c)". `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/resolution/plan.ts` row 3c maps deposit-present + pin-absent to `proceed` with a warning, so `updateStateFromPlan` reports `current`.

Failure mode: after the scaffolder drops the pin, re-running `directive init` or `directive update` re-appends the AGENTS.md managed section (`agentsRefreshPlan` state `missing`) and the `.gitignore` lines, then reports current. `package.json` stays unpinned. The only writer of a pin from null is `ensurePackageJsonPin` inside `runInitDeposit`, which is unreachable once `.deft/core` exists.

Consequence: a lean that names "re-run init / update" as the re-assert cannot bind. The lean must either name a pin write in the update path for the deposit-present + pin-absent state, or scope pin recovery out in words. Existing machinery covers the hard part: `reconstituteConsumerPinAndLock` already runs the closed lockfile-only argv (#4710); only the null-pin gate blocks it.

Steelman for keeping row 3c: it stops `update` from editing `package.json` on consumers that never pinned. What flips it: a policy opt-out, or accepting that #4429 already made "pinned" the converged state. No on-disk signal at this SHA separates "pin lost" from "never pinned" (`VERSION` `fetched_by` and `GENERATION.json` `stampedBy` are rewritten by update).

### F2 — Refuse-on-change and lock forks cannot see this failure

`sharpens-framing`

Evidence: issue body timeline (described content): Directive files ~11:23:33, `package.json` overwritten again ~11:23:35 by the scaffolder's package-manager step. `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts` writes via `containedWrite` mode `replace`; a grep of `packages/core/src/init-deposit` at the SHA finds no advisory lock, mtime check, or exclusive-create path. `create-next-app` and npm honor no lock init could take.

Failure mode: a re-read-after-write check only covers init's process lifetime. An overwrite two seconds later, possibly after exit, escapes it. A lock is honored by nobody else. Torn writes are not the mode either; the foreign process wrote a complete stale image.

Consequence: drop refuse and serialize as primary remedies, or state them as best-effort. The design center is post-hoc detection plus idempotent repair (F1). One deterministic detector already exists: init stages `package.json`, `AGENTS.md`, `.gitignore` (`installerManagedMatchers` in `hygiene.ts`, `depositStagePaths`), so index-vs-worktree divergence on those paths is exactly the signal the reporter saw ("the index still had the pin"). It lasts until the operator commits.

### F3 — Scaffold-then-init is not a clean ordering either

`sharpens-framing`

Evidence: `assertLockfileAllowsPinWrite` in `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.ts` throws when any lockfile exists and the exact pin is absent, before any deposit. `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.test.ts` locks it: "refuses the pin write when a lockfile exists without the exact pin (#4429)". A finished `create-next-app` leaves `package-lock.json`.

Failure mode: init-first gets overwritten (this issue); scaffold-first refuses and deposits nothing until the operator hand-adds the pin and refreshes the lockfile.

Consequence: a "document init-after-scaffold only" disposition binds only if it names that manual step. The cheaper road is inventory reuse: init calls the same closed lockfile-only argv update already uses instead of refusing, which turns the refusal into the merge the issue asks for.

### F4 — The brownfield label is the hasGit rule, not the race

`sharpens-framing`

Evidence: `decideInitDispatch` returns `brownfield-install` when `hasAppCode || hasGit`. `git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-dispatch.test.ts` asserts `hasGit` alone yields `brownfield-install`. At classify time the scaffolder's `package.json` already existed (11:23:12 < 11:23:33), so `hasAppCode` was also true. Both `scaffold` and `brownfield-install` call the same `runInitDepositCli` with identical arguments.

Failure mode: none behavioral. The label text "app code, no Directive deposit" misdescribes a README-only clone.

Consequence: "a README-only repo should stay greenfield" is not evidence of the race and is contradicted by a tested rule. Remove it from this issue's acceptance or split it as a label-text fix.

### F5 — Gate stamp inventories the wrong AGENTS.md writer

`footnote`

`cmd/deft-install` `WriteAgentsMD` is the frozen Go bridge. Live `directive init` routes `git show 3013fc2b:packages/cli/src/init-cli/init.ts` → `runInitDispatchCli` → TS `writeAgentsMd` → `agentsRefreshPlan` (`git show 3013fc2b:packages/core/src/platform/agents-md.ts`), whose `missing` state appends the managed section after existing prose. Inventory that path.

### F6 — Doctor signal strength is unverified from the tree

`footnote`

At this SHA the missing pin is a plan warning and a reconciliation line (`doctor/main.ts` `resolveReconciliationLine`), and a missing managed section is `severity: "warning"`. Neither drives doctor's exit code. The reporter's "green only after that merge" cannot be attributed to these checks from tree evidence.

Open critique of [#4533](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4533) P1 (concurrent scaffolder vs pin + managed AGENTS.md). Re-measured at dispatch SHA `3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864` via `git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:<path>` (dest HEAD equals that SHA). In-envelope thread: [5780278401](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4533#issuecomment-5780278401), Stop 1 [5799040749](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4533#issuecomment-5799040749), panel-deposit [5799053370](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4533#issuecomment-5799053370).

## Inventory

Existing writers already merge at call time:

- `assertLockfileAllowsPinWrite` in `git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.ts` refuses a present lockfile whose `package.json` does not already carry the exact pin. It runs before `reconstituteDepositFromContent`. It does not re-run after writes.
- `ensurePackageJsonPin` in `git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts` reads current `package.json` and sets `@deftai/directive` as an exact devDependency. Absent file → create; present file → merge fields. Write is `containedProjectWrite` `mode: "replace"`.
- `writeAgentsMd` in the same file plans via `agentsRefreshPlan` and replace-writes. Foreign AGENTS.md with no managed sentinel is `state: "missing"` → `wrapLegacyInMarkers` (append). It does not call `applyAgentsRefresh`.
- `applyAgentsRefresh` in `git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/platform/agents-md.ts` takes `withAppendLock` on AGENTS.md (#1329) for Directive install/upgrade/migrate/refresh writers. Init's `writeAgentsMd` is outside that lock.
- `ensureInitGitignoreLines` in `git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/init-deposit/gitignore.ts` reconciles canonical lines into the current `.gitignore`.
- `cmd/deft-install` `WriteAgentsMD` (`git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:cmd/deft-install/setup.go`) creates / surgical-rewrites / appends. Same call-time merge. `directive init` on the reported 0.118.1 engine is the TS dispatcher.
- `runInitDispatchCli` classifies once, then `scaffold` and `brownfield-install` both call `runInitDepositCli` (`git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-dispatch.ts`).
- `runInitDeposit` order: lockfile refuse → copy `.deft/core` → `ensurePackageJsonPin` → gitignore → `writeAgentsMd` → hooks / generation stamp. After the first `writeAgentsMd` there is no second pin write, no second AGENTS.md write, no `readPin`. `buildInstallSummaryJson` sets `deposit_completed: true` from hook readiness.
- `directive update` / `refresh.ts` already calls `ensurePackageJsonPin` and `writeAgentsMd` again.
- contained-write `O_EXCL` is `mode: "create"` only (`git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts`). Init projections use replace. No flock on consumer `package.json` / `AGENTS.md` / `.gitignore` in the init-deposit writers.

Blob assertions on those `git show` paths: hasGit-or-hasAppCode brownfield; shared deposit CLI; classify-once; lockfile refuse before copy; pin→gitignore→AGENTS.md inside `runInitDeposit`; no re-assert after `writeAgentsMd`; install JSON omits pin postcondition; pin merge + replace write; `writeAgentsMd` unlocked; `#1329` lock on `applyAgentsRefresh`; foreign AGENTS wrap; plan 3c proceed on null pin; doctor skip on missing markers; no flock in init writers; update reapplies pin and AGENTS.md.

## Findings

### F1 `blocks-the-design`: bind one postcondition sequence; the Expected three-way fork does not close P1

Evidence. Stop 1 records P1 as pin + managed AGENTS.md overwritten in the same window, with open forks refuse / merge / re-assert / lock / docs-only. The repro timestamps are Next files ~11:23:12, Directive files ~11:23:33, Next `package.json` again ~11:23:35. `ensurePackageJsonPin` already is merge. `writeAgentsMd` already is append-or-rewrite. Those run once. `assertLockfileAllowsPinWrite` already is refuse, and it is a start-of-init check. `#1329` already is an advisory lock among Directive writers, and init does not take it. `create-next-app` does not take `AGENTS.md.lock`. Replace-write plus a non-participating last writer is lost-update. A lockfile that appears after the refuse recreates the unreconstitutable pin/lock mismatch #4429 was written to prevent.

Failure mode. Init returns success (`deposit_completed: true`, stdout "AGENTS.md : updated") while the working tree is a Next app (`tmp-app`), the managed section is gone, and the next agent session loads Next agent-rules. That is the adoption-blocker in [5780278401](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4533#issuecomment-5780278401): first real project work deletes the install's bookkeeping.

Disposition. A successor lean binds P1 when Bound remedy is this sequence, using the writers already in inventory: before init reports success, re-read `readPin` + managed-section presence; if either is missing, call `ensurePackageJsonPin` and `writeAgentsMd` (gitignore too if the lean includes `.gitignore`); if still missing, non-zero refuse that names re-run `directive init` / `directive update` after the other scaffolder is quiet. Expected "refuse, merge, or re-assert" collapses onto re-assert-then-refuse. A new flock / exclusive create / docs-only "init after scaffold" line does not bind. An in-process mtime check with no re-apply still loses the 11:23:35 write.

### F2 `sharpens-framing`: the brownfield state line is the hasGit classifier, printed before deposit

Evidence. `decideInitDispatch` returns `brownfield-install` when `facts.hasAppCode || facts.hasGit`. `classify` sets `hasGit` from `.git` as dir or file (`git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/resolution/classify.ts`). `package.json` is an `APP_CODE_MARKERS` entry. Label text is `brownfield project (app code, no Directive deposit)` — the string in Actual. `printInitDispatchSummary` runs before `runScaffold`. `init-dispatch.test.ts` locks `hasGit: true` → `brownfield-install`. Both dispatch arms call the same `runInitDepositCli`.

Failure mode. Binding "a README-only repo should stay greenfield" recuts #2265 independently of last-writer-wins. A cloned GitHub README is brownfield today with no Next process. The same label also fires when Next's `package.json` lands before classify. Treating the label as proof of the race mixes two defects and can ship a classifier change that leaves P1 open.

Disposition. Drop the greenfield-label success criterion from this Bound remedy. If README-only greenfield remains wanted, leftover-split a classifier issue. Race work stays on the terminal pin + AGENTS.md postcondition, which both dispatch arms already share.

### F3 `sharpens-framing`: doctor --full is proceed+note on a stripped pin, and skips a replaced AGENTS.md

Evidence. `plan()` row 3c (`git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/resolution/plan.ts`): `hasDeftCore` and `pinVersion === null` returns `proceed` plus warning "no committed package.json pin"; comment cites #4429 (error would retro-fail pre-pin consumers). Doctor resolution `actionRequired` is `plan.mode !== "proceed"`; 3c therefore prints proceed and `note:` the warning. `runAgentsMdFreshnessCheck` in `git show 3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864:packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` skips when `!hasManagedSectionMarker` with "no managed-section markers (likely maintainer repo)". `packages/core/src/session` has no `hasManagedSection` consumers. `refresh.ts` already re-applies pin and AGENTS.md.

Failure mode. Hanging P1 on "doctor was green only after hand-merge" treats a warning/note (and a skipped AGENTS.md check) as a fail-closed gate. `.deft/core` survives Next. First session still reads Next AGENTS.md. Hand-merge duplicated `ensurePackageJsonPin`; `directive update` already does that merge.

Disposition. Keep doctor --full out of Bound remedy as the P1 control. Optional leftover, separate from F1: when an install manifest / `.deft/GENERATION.json` records a completed init and the pin is absent, route plan to `update` (pin-stripped). Leave 3c for trees that never had a pin.

### F4 `footnote`

Actual lists `.gitignore`; Expected names pin and AGENTS.md. `ensureInitGitignoreLines` is the same call-time reconcile. Fold it into F1's terminal re-apply if the lean wants that file in the invariant.

Issue body `Refs #1709` is described content. Stop 1 already excluded value-feedback. Do not pull #1709 into this remedy.

## Injection / swarm

The target changes installer identity (exact pin, managed AGENTS.md), concurrency (overlapping `create-next-app`), and shared consumer files. The foreign scaffolder is an untrusted writer relative to those invariants. Advisory `AGENTS.md.lock` and contained replace do not bind a non-participant. The deterministic control is init's own success postcondition on pin + managed section (F1), with update as the named recovery when the window continues after process exit.

## Road-not-taken

Exclusive lock on `package.json` / `AGENTS.md` / `.gitignore`. Strongest case: two Directive inits would serialize, which #1329 already does for `agents:refresh`. Flip if the foreign scaffolder honored a documented lock path.

Docs-only "run init after the app scaffold." Strongest case: a quiet tree makes F1's refuse branch rare. Flip if first-project concurrent create stopped being the high-likelihood path named in [5780278401](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4533#issuecomment-5780278401).

Refuse-only with no re-apply. Strongest case: simpler, and a later `directive init` delegates to update which already merges. Flip if init never reports success without the F1 postcondition, because the poisoned first agent session is the adoption-blocker.

What flips F1: a measured postcondition after `stampLiveGeneration` that re-reads pin + managed section, re-applies the existing writers once, fails closed when still missing, and a test that replaces `package.json` and `AGENTS.md` after the first write and before return.

audit-targets: none

The overwrite defect remains at `3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864`. The remedy needs a bounded success contract and a recovery path that actually restores a missing pin. I favor detecting and refusing observed conflicts, then repairing after scaffolding finishes. Repeated re-assertion against a live writer is not a safe default. The README-only classification is a separate, reproducible defect.

Reviewed the issue body and comments through **5799053370**, inclusive. Open critique; the recorded refutation-target and thread imperatives are proposal data, not instructions. No implementation, ingest, occupancy claim, or sibling-post reads.

Existing mechanisms, rechecked at that SHA:

- [`ensurePackageJsonPin` and `writeAgentsMd`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864/packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts#L209) already merge the pin into existing JSON and use `agentsRefreshPlan` to preserve prose outside the managed section. [`ensureInitGitignoreLines`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864/packages/core/src/init-deposit/gitignore.ts#L244) already reconciles ignore entries. A quiescent fixture preserved app scripts, Next rules, and app ignore entries while restoring Directive content.
- The Go [`WriteAgentsMD`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864/cmd/deft-install/setup.go#L787) also handles absent, managed, legacy, and foreign-only files; it is not limited to a legacy-sentinel rewrite. The npm init path uses the TypeScript writer.
- [`applyAgentsRefresh`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864/packages/core/src/platform/agents-md.ts#L513) already has an advisory `AGENTS.md.lock` and atomic-write path. Init’s `writeAgentsMd` calls the planner directly instead. Thus “no concurrent-writer lock” is accurate for these init writes, not for the whole AGENTS subsystem. Neither advisory locking nor atomic replacement compels an unrelated scaffolder to cooperate.

Checks used Node 24 to execute SHA-pinned TypeScript source with types/import wiring removed. Filesystem writers, pin reader, AGENTS parser/planner, ignore reconciler, classifier, and init control flow were exercised on temporary fixtures. Unrelated deposits and hook readiness were stubbed; staging used real Git on the three target files. Controlled interleavings replace timing sleeps. These are source-level reproductions, **not** a full `create-next-app` end-to-end run or evidence of the historical process-exit time.

## 1. blocks-the-design — Bound the concurrency guarantee; pin presence alone does not prove safety

**Evidence:** [`runInitDeposit`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864/packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-deposit.ts#L351) writes pin/ignore/AGENTS once, later stages, then stamps generation and returns. Injecting a foreign overwrite after those writes but before staging produced exit `0`, `success: true`, and generation-stamp invocation with all three Directive invariants absent. Overwriting immediately after staging produced the same success, with the pin retained in the index but absent from the working file. Separately, an injected package write between `ensurePackageJsonPin`’s read and write lost the scaffolder’s newly added build script while leaving the Directive pin present.

**Failure mode:** A final pin/managed-marker check alone can miss app content already lost by a stale read/merge/write. A one-time re-assertion, mtime check, advisory lock, or atomic rename cannot prevent an uncooperative writer from replacing the file after the last observation. The incident timestamps establish ordering, not whether the last overwrite preceded init’s return.

**Disposition:** The broad “safe in the same window” promise cannot bind without defining the observation interval and supported writer coordination. First-ship acceptance should cover detected drift, preservation of foreign content, and truthful partial-failure reporting before success; include `.gitignore` and the staged/working divergence. Refusal must not restore stale whole-file snapshots or reset unrelated staged work. A stronger no-lost-update guarantee needs serialization that includes the scaffolder. Later overwrites remain an explicit limit, not something a final re-read can prevent.

## 2. blocks-the-design — “Finish scaffolding, then rerun init” does not currently restore the missing pin

**Evidence:** [`init-dispatch.ts`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864/packages/core/src/init-deposit/init-dispatch.ts#L76) delegates an existing deposit to update. In [`refresh.ts`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/3013fc2bc37fcca3be036f093cda4d94878d8864/packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts#L759), `pinLagsReconstitutedVersion` requires `current !== null`; `reconstituteConsumerPinAndLock` returns immediately otherwise. On the overwritten-package fixture, the actual repair helper returned `null` with **zero pin-writer calls**.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

`directive init` is not safe if another scaffolder writes the same files in the same window. On a new `deftai/CarExpenseTracker` install (engine 0.118.1), `create-next-app` and `directive init --yes` both wrote `package.json`, `AGENTS.md`, and `.gitignore`.

## Expected

Init should refuse, merge, or re-assert the `@deftai/directive` pin and managed `AGENTS.md` section if those files change under it. A README-only repo should stay greenfield.

## Actual

- Working `package.json` became a Next.js app named `tmp-app` (Next 16 / React 19).
- The index still had the Directive pin `@deftai/directive@0.118.1`.
- `AGENTS.md` was replaced by the Next.js agent-rules block.
- Init JSON reported `brownfield project (app code, no Directive deposit)` for a repo that had only a GitHub README when init started.

Hand-merge recovered the pin. `directive doctor --full` was green only after that merge.

## Notes

Repro is timing-dependent: Next files landed ~11:23:12, Directive files ~11:23:33, then Next overwrote `package.json` again ~11:23:35. Consumer: `deftai/CarExpenseTracker`.

Refs #1709

admitted_source_sentences: Before init reports success, re-read `readPin` and managed-section presence (and `.gitignore` if that file is in the invariant).
If either pin or managed section is missing, call the existing writers once (`ensurePackageJsonPin`, `writeAgentsMd`, `ensureInitGitignoreLines`).
If still missing, non-zero refuse that names re-run `directive init` / `directive update` after the other scaffolder is quiet.
Expected "refuse, merge, or re-assert" collapses onto re-assert-then-refuse.
A new flock / exclusive-create / docs-only "init after scaffold" line does not bind.
Deposit-present + pin-absent restores the pin with `ensurePackageJsonPin` at the recorded deposit version (`previousDepositVersion` / `.deft/core/VERSION`).
Do not route this null-pin hole through `reconstituteConsumerPinAndLock` (that path writes running `contentVersion` and may spawn lockfile-only).
Lockfile appearance / unpinned lockfile stays leftover on #4429.
Drop the sentence that a matching package.json pin plus an empty lockfile is not recovery from this remainder.
Drop "a README-only repo should stay greenfield" from this Bound remedy.
If README-only classification remains wanted, leftover-split a classifier issue.
Keep `doctor --full` out of Bound remedy as the P1 control.
Later overwrite after process exit remains an explicit limit.
Advisory `AGENTS.md.lock` does not bind a non-participating scaffolder.
A test that replaces `package.json` and `AGENTS.md` after the first write and before return is the fixture.
